description: Tracks active open-source AI agent repositories from GitHub signals.

items.description: AI productivity studio with smart chat, autonomous agents, and 300+ assistants. Unified access to frontier LLMs
Open-source agent for the terminal written in Rust. Use any provider or model. Issues & PRs always welcome
Scale computer-use 2.0 with open-source drivers, cross-OS sandboxes, and benchmarks for training, evaluation, and data generation.
Consider it done. The open-source AI agent that works out of the box · 想到，就能做到。开源、开箱即用的 AI Agent。
TSP自托管、零运维的 A 股「自建策略 + 监控 + 回测」量化工作台  | LLM能力驱使策略定制+个股分析+复盘 | 自由接入第三方数据源与个性化扩展数据 | 个人开源

Open-source, self-hosted alternative to Claude Duet: AI coworkers (named agents) with instructions, memory, routines, their own isolated computer, and your approval before they act. Also an alternative to OpenAI Dots, Meta Muse, Grok Bot, Manus Cue and ChatGPT agent.
AI Agent 驱动的开源可自部署视频工作台：将小说与剧本转为角色、场景、道具资产、分镜、视频和剪映草稿，支持跨镜头一致性、多供应商与费用追踪 | Self-hosted AI video workspace for stories, storyboards and short-form video production
A persistent workspace for development work that self-improves and continues beyond one session.

Open-source AI video workbench. Bring any model or your local ComfyUI, and let Claude Code / Codex / Cursor direct it over MCP — storyboard, references, generation, editable first cut on a real timeline. Local-first: projects, prompts, and keys stay on your machine. No account, no telemetry.
Kition brings Markdown, DataTable, WhiteBoard, a tool-using AI agent, browser research, and visual workflows into one desktop workspace.

The first AI agent harness native to the browser. A browser extension that runs a full agent loop where you already work: it drives your tabs, spins up sandboxed compute (JS notebooks, WASM Linux VMs, client-side apps), and shares what it builds peer-to-peer. BYOK, no backend, no telemetry.

Open-source GrokBot alternative built on DeepSeek Harness. Build your personal bot team: multiple personal agents with persistent memory, identities and permissions, extensible through DSH plugins.｜基于 DeepSeek Harness 的开源 GrokBot 平替：有长期记忆的个人 AI Bot 团队，支持多 Bot 协作、身份权限与插件生态扩展。MIT.

Use your ChatGPT Plus / Pro (Codex) subscription in DeepSeek Harness (DSH): GPT-6 & Codex models, images, web search and quota via ChatGPT sign-in — no OpenAI API key. Beta: control DSH from the ChatGPT mobile app. 在 DSH 中使用 ChatGPT 订阅，并可用 ChatGPT 手机 App 远程控制。
Quant infrastructure for AI agents — a free, open-source desktop workspace for macOS and Windows where your Claude Code or Codex turns a trading idea into a backtested strategy and runs it live.
A coding agent: give it a prompt and it reads, writes, runs commands, and searches code in a loop until the work is done, using native tool-calling across OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google models.
